nodes.title: Literature survey
nodes.goal: Collect the ten most cited papers on PCB layout rules for 48 V GaN half-bridges and summarise each in two lines.
nodes.acceptance: survey.md holds a Markdown table with exactly 10 rows, each with title, year, venue, DOI and a two-line summary.
nodes.scope_in: Public web pages, open-access PDFs, the docs/ folder of this graph.
nodes.scope_out: Paywalled full texts; anything outside this graph folder.
nodes.already_known: The EPC application notes AN009 and AN027 are already read; do not list them.

deliverables.description: Markdown table of 10 papers with DOI and two-line summary

do_nots: Do not invent DOIs; leave the cell empty if unknown

nodes.title: Layout rule set
nodes.goal: Turn the survey into a numbered set of layout rules with a numeric limit for each (loop inductance, clearance, via count).
nodes.acceptance: rules.md lists at least 12 numbered rules, each citing at least one survey row; check_rules.py runs with python and prints PASS for the bundled example.
nodes.scope_in: The survey deliverable, Python 3 standard library.
nodes.already_known: Target power-loop inductance is below 1 nH; 4-layer stack-up with 0.2 mm prepreg.

deliverables.description: Numbered layout rules with numeric limits and citations
Stand-alone checker for the numeric rules with a bundled example

do_nots: Do not use third-party Python packages
Do not edit the survey deliverable
nodes.extra_context: Prefer rules that a reviewer can check from a Gerber viewer.

nodes.title: Two-page report
nodes.goal: Write a two-page report that explains the rule set to a hardware engineer who has not read the papers.
nodes.acceptance: report.md is between 700 and 1100 words, references every rule number once, and ends with a list of open questions.

deliverables.description: Two-page explanatory report with open questions
